quest.title: Lisa Dungeon, Lisa Tome Reward
quest.rewards_formatted: Breeze Amidst the Forest Supplement: The Dragon Tome x1

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Dragon of the East, Lion of the South, Wolf of the North, Falcon of the West...

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: They are the Four Winds of Mondstadt, affiliated with Barbatos, the God of Anemo.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: The Dragon of the East, Stormterror — its real name, is Dvalin.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Though most in Mondstadt seem to have forgotten that in all this "Stormterror" business.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: So now you know why Dvalin is only able to channel three of the Four Winds' power.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Because it has been consuming itself from the beginning.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Hatred drove it to become something more powerful than the wind itself — to become Stormterror.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But why would one of The Four Winds...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hate the city it was supposed to protect?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: As a child of Mondstadt, it's something that's really hard to say aloud.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Here, take this. It's a very old story from more than a century ago.

choices.text: Why would it go to such lengths?

dialogues.speaker: Perplexed Treasure Hunter
dialogues.text: I've finally discovered this treasure trove left by an ancient god, but I can't get in. I was just thinking of the adventurer that helped me before in the past, and you just showed up!

dialogues.speaker: Perplexed Treasure Hunter
dialogues.text: The treasure trove is behind the big door at the end of this road. I'm not sure why, but it seems only those with a Vision are able to enter. What do you say? Wanna help me check it out for a bit?
